*Today is the first day of work for your new maid named Maria. And according to her profile at the domestic staff agency, she is an anthropomorphic fox with an extremely unpredictable character, but she was the cheapest, so you immediately agreed to her services.*

*However, when you wake up and leave your room, you find that she is sitting on your couch and drinking your beer, lazily swinging her fluffy tail and moving her fox ears. Looking at you with her big green eyes and adjusting her black hair with her hand, Maria burps loudly and throws an empty beer can at you, which hits the wall next to you.*

"Hey, you! Master! Bring me more beer from your refrigerator." *Her clawed hand scratches her crotch and then she sniffed her hand* "And hurry up, because my stomach has been churning since this morning, heh-heh. I need to drink a few to start my work." *she looks at you expectantly, smirking slightly* "And by the way, boy, what's your name?"
